text:
alyssa-cs: Hey team — MeridianX (renewal in 3 months) just requested help onboarding a custom NER model for retail returns. They want a private deployment (VPC + customer KMS/HSM), PHI/PII redaction rules, and a tied reranker for candidate resolution. Timeline: pilot in 6 weeks. They provided sample data and an initial label schema. Can we intake?

jordan-solutions: Thanks Alyssa — quick q's: what QPS and 99p latency they expect? also model size target (13B, 7B, custom)?

alyssa-cs: Customer wants < 200ms 99p for single-turn NER inference, and burst to ~150 qps during batch imports. They prefer a ~7B or quantized 13B if we can hit latency. Data: ~120k annotated spans, JSONL. They want on-prem style network controls + audit logs.

mina-ml: Sounds doable. We'll need: 1) sample schema + negative cases 2) a small eval set (2000 items) for regression checks 3) inference profile (seq len distribution). Can you drop sample files to the intake link? Also: for PHI redaction, we should add a safety post-processing step rather than baking redaction into model if they want deterministic removal.

sam-product: FYI we should treat this as a Tier 1 Dedicated/Private sale — product/enablement should own the rollout docs and playbook. I'll prep a checklist: onboarding runbook, canary rollout steps, fallback model mapping.

sec-team: They mentioned PHI and customer-managed KMS. We need DPA + SOC2 attestation copy and proof of HSM support. Also confirm whether the sample data is de-identified; please do not upload PHI into our shared buckets until legal signs off.

infra-oncall: For 150 qps bursts + <200ms 99p, recommend Dedicated pool with autoscale and a small warm standby. If they insist on private infra we need to size for concurrency; flagging possible need for 2x GPUs with faster interconnect.

jordan-solutions: I'll run a dry eval with our harness once we get the sample JSONL. Plan: initial eval for precision/recall + latency. Example eval config I'm going to use:```json
{
  "task": "ner",
  "metrics": ["span_precision","span_recall","f1"],
  "latency_target_ms": 200,
  "sample_size": 2000
}
```

mina-ml: For model variant recommendation we should test: fp16 7B, int8 13B, and 7B + caching. We'll capture tokenization edge cases for product labels. Also propose adding a reranker eval for candidate disambiguation (MRR / top-1 accuracy).

alyssa-cs: I uploaded the sample to the MeridianX intake folder and shared the link with the customer (they confirmed no raw PHI in the sample). Link: https://redwood.internal/s3/meridianx/intake-2026-03-21

sec-team: Received. Legal looped in for DPA. Please remind MeridianX to sign the private deployment addendum.

jordan-solutions: Created a Jira for the onboarding work: RWI-4821 (private-ner: meridianx). Adding assignees: @mina-ml for evals, @infra-oncall for sizing, @sam-product for rollout.

jira-bot: Jira ticket RWI-4821 created and linked to this thread. https://jira.redwood/rwi-4821

sam-product: I'll schedule an enablement session for the customer and internal on-call. Proposed dates: next Wed 1400-1500 PT. Alyssa, can you confirm?

alyssa-cs: Confirmed — I'll set meeting and invite MeridianX PM as observer. Also flagging renewal risk: customer expects this feature in pilot to consider renewing; want tight communication.

mina-ml: Next steps for us: 1) run eval on provided 2k test set 2) produce a short technical note with recommended model variant + quantization and expected cost/QPS 3) capture safety post-processing recipe. I'll post results here in 3 business days.

infra-oncall: I'll draft sizing + Dedicated pool config and include warm-standby policy and autoscale thresholds.

alyssa-cs: Great — thanks team. I'll follow up after the enablement is scheduled. :thumbsup:
